notes: Lead source: inbound via blog + API signup. Small SMB (12 engineers, support org of 6). Use case: automate ticket summarization + enrichment and enable tool-calling to create/update their internal ticketing system. Key asks: 1) structured JSON outputs (category, priority, agent_suggest, summary) for deterministic parsing; 2) tool calling to execute ticket updates and doc retrieval; 3) latency: p95 < 500ms for single-turn summarization, peak throughput ~200 req/min (mostly short contexts); 4) cost-sensitive — want to keep token cost low, leaning toward Redwood hosted API if unit economics are good. Security: require SSO (SAML) for console, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence. Data residency: US only (public cloud fine). Customer quote: "We need reliable JSON outputs we can map into our enrichment pipeline — anything fuzzy breaks our automations." POC plan: 2-week trial using hosted API with sample ticket dataset (anonymized). SE notes: try batched summary endpoint + prefix caching on similar ticket templates. Potential blockers listed above. Links: drive deck attached, original signup gmail thread. Next: share pricing tiers, retention policy, lightweight PII redaction example, and lock 30m kickoff (Arjun to own POC runbook).
